sentences.text: Cette nuit, une vache de Sarah a donné naissance à un petit veau.
sentences.en: Last night, one of Sarah's cows gave birth to a little calf.
sentences.ko: 어젯밤 사라의 소 한 마리가 작은 송아지를 낳았어요.

sentences.text: Antoine sert le thé à la menthe à la fin de chaque repas.
sentences.en: Antoine serves mint tea at the end of every meal.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 식사가 끝날 때마다 박하차를 내요.

sentences.text: Sarah cultive de la menthe le long du mur du potager.
sentences.en: Sarah grows mint along the wall of the vegetable garden.
sentences.ko: 사라는 텃밭 담장을 따라 박하를 길러요.
